cases.reviewerAnswer: cerrar: to close; the relevant present forms are cierra and cierran.
cuarto: a quarter of an hour; masculine. Y cuarto adds fifteen minutes; menos cuarto subtracts fifteen.
festivo: a public holiday in the substantive use shown; masculine; plural festivos.
horario: schedule or opening hours; masculine; plural horarios.
media: half an hour in this use; las tres y media means 3:30, Ukrainian "пів на четверту".
mediodía: noon; masculine; the written accent is required.
salir: to go out or depart; el tren sale means the train departs.
